betterMoveDoes: Playing col c2 (drop at c2r2) keeps a razor-thin zugzwang win that resolves only as the board fills (~ply 42); the played move col c3 (drop at c3r2) lets it slip to a draw. No winning four or standing threat is nameable within 26 plies, and an empty-square parity count would mislabel the controller, so no cell can be named.
